desc.SEVEN: numeral-7 hook (key: o); bold long-bar variants merged in
desc.OMEGABAR: omega/w with a bar on top (key: null N10)
desc.SIX: 6 / b, loop at base with ascender (key: n1/n2)
desc.ELOOP: small script e/h loop (key: h or i2)
desc.TWOFLAT: flat 2 / z with baseline, incl. 2 D-shapes (NOT in key)
desc.EIGHTBAR: 8 crossed by a bar (NOT in key)
desc.XCURL: cursive x with curled ends (NOT in key; key d zigzag?)
desc.THETA: circle crossed by a horizontal bar (NOT in key)
desc.HCURL: H-shape with curled serifs (key: word code under Prince of Castile, per the image; N4 per pass A)
desc.OMEGA2: omega without bar, open w (key: N10 variant?)
desc.LL: two verticals on a baseline (NOT in key)
desc.ENN: bold N (NOT in key; or N6)
desc.PHI: phi loop on a descender, crossed (key: a)
desc.CBOLD: bold C with flag (key: r? or N9)
desc.RHO: P/rho loop with descender (key: I word code? or s)
desc.TLOOP: cross with a loop, t-like (key: t? or b)
desc.UCURL: u-curl with tail, gamma-like (key: u or N1)
desc.RSTROKE: r with a flat stroke (key: t1?)
desc.STROKE: isolated stroke, usually a fragment of a split sign or half of an LL pair
